youtube.title: Which country did the first human heart transplant? Not the one you think 🫀
youtube.description:
The country with the biggest hospitals, the one with the oldest medical schools, or the third one? The first human heart transplant was done one night in December by a surgeon most of the world had never heard of, the patient woke and spoke, and the news beat the big medical powers to it by weeks.
Which did you pick?
